objective: Localize the faulted feeder section from fault-current-indicator states and outage complaints.

objective.en: Use FCI states and outage complaints to infer the most likely faulted radial feeder section.
objective.ru: Использовать состояния FCI и жалобы об отключениях для определения наиболее вероятного повреждённого участка радиального фидера.

instructions.en: Use fault_localization_case. Compare each candidate faulted section with the observed FCI states and customer outage complaint nodes. Report faulted_section and affected_customer_nodes.
instructions.ru: Используйте fault_localization_case. Сопоставьте каждый кандидатный повреждённый участок с наблюдаемыми состояниями FCI и узлами жалоб потребителей. Укажите faulted_section и affected_customer_nodes.

public_inputs.calculation_spec: For each candidate faulted section, derive which upstream FCI locations should see fault current and which downstream customer nodes should be outaged. Choose the section with minimum mismatch against observed FCI states and complaints.

hard_constraints: Faulted section must minimize FCI and complaint mismatch under the public radial model.
Affected customer nodes must match the inferred downstream customer set.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether submitted localization satisfies all hard constraints.

source_provenance.title: Brown, Faulted Circuit Indicators and System Reliability
source_provenance.notes: Grounds FCI indications, patrol direction and outage localization; the case is a compact radial-feeder graph instance.
